parent.known_negative: F100 was source-only PRESTO; F101 native structural provenance passed source-only; no evidence yet that training adds downstream causal retention.

objective: Use actual frozen Y-F62 native 72-event 144B online memory action space and delayed downstream question correctness as TRAIN-only counterfactual credit; test whether the learned action ranking preserves future compositional answers on untouched public synthetic negative-seed guard cases.

train.delayed_credit_teacher: exact frozen F62 counterfactual_labels at indices 11,23,35,47,59,71, with suffix and eventual question as OFFLINE TRAIN labels only; online feature scoring must not see question or future
train.train_updates: four passes over the same frozen TRAIN-only action-credit rows, per-action gradient 0.04; score tanh(linear(feature delta)); tanh residual error against delta in {-1,0,1}

variants.raw: unclipped, unnormalized standard 12-feature tanh SGD, source-only reference
variants.clip: same fit, per-example update vector L2 norm clipped to <=0.08; no other change
variants.normalized: same fit, normalize each 12-feature dimension with TRAIN-only rms>=0.05 before updates and evaluation, frozen TRAIN statistics
variants.residual: same fit with per-update weight-state residual update scaling 0.25 (gradient unchanged)
variants.bounded_depth: same learned raw model but online reject native actions producing any record with >4 signed-role codes; do not modify inherited native F62 candidate generation

other_controls: actual frozen F62/F60 native fixed merge-and-evict, no training
actual frozen F62/F61 previously fitted 12-feature quantized weights, no F102 retraining
TRAIN-only two-hidden-unit tanh MLP on same 12 relative action features: 29 trainable scalars, 4 passes, 0.04 step, no pretrained embedding; larger-capacity comparator NOT equal parameter count
train.attribution: Use exact F101 structural record/role witness on a bounded 4/6-hop subset of final actual retained memories, including single-record deletion necessity and native 144B receipt; no online access to answer from trace.
train.training_repeated_cycles: Log per cycle fit loss, weight norm, nonfinite count, clipped count and TRAIN-only residual prediction quality. Never select model with guard outcomes.
train.prevent_leakage: All candidate features computed via native.actions from observed memory/public edge and current time only. No future question, answer, true core label, seed/family ID, future suffix or F101 offline attribution fed to the online policy.

guard.name: F102-A-ordinary-new-graph
guard.mode: untouched F62 public generator, new source identities

guard.name: F102-B-signed-role-remap
guard.mode: permute role alphabet and invert every observed edge direction plus query directions

guard.name: F102-C-reverse-arrival
guard.mode: reverse arrival ordering, no query leaks

guard.name: F102-D-phase-reshuffle
guard.mode: all even-index public edges then odd-index public edges, with independent role-alphabet permutation

frozen_screen.validity: All 16 TRAIN / 32 GUARD episodes generated and disjoint, same codec / native 12-record budget, all selected action space source-native except declared bounded-depth action filtering, all questions hidden until terminal memory, same 72 events and query per episode for every arm; no use of reserved source identities; no guard train/retune.
frozen_screen.engineering_pass: No nonfinite update; real source-native actions and memory constraints, 4 declared cycles, complete all-arm all-guard case-level outcomes, F101 source attribution on declared subset and Linux/Windows consistency.
frozen_screen.scientific_positive_only_if: Raw learned policy exceeds native F60 fixed correct count by >=4/32 overall, suffers no loss in any guard block versus native F60, and beats previously fixed F61 and zero-score F62 controls. Otherwise retain NEGATIVE even if some variants do better.
frozen_screen.stability_claim_only_if: Clipping or normalization variant improves minimum guard-family correct by >=2 without lowering pooled correct relative to raw and shows lower train update norm. Otherwise no demonstrated stability improvement.
frozen_screen.mlp_limit: Tiny 2-hidden-unit MLP is 29 params not 12: report separate counts and inference work, never call tightly parameter-matched. No GRU/Transformer/GNN baseline in F102; downstream experiment required.
frozen_screen.structural_transfer_limit: Guard uses new native graph identities and transformed roles / arrival ordering but reuses F62 generator topology. Do not claim transfer across unrelated graph families.
frozen_screen.no_hindsight: Any bug fix after GUARD evaluated must preserve entire prereg, exact recorded earlier run and source-head lineage; never redefine gate to make a negative positive. Tests can succeed while scientific comparison is negative.
